title: Untitled (Figure, Blue Ground)
description: Vertical mixed-media collage on red ground incorporating compact discs at each corner, a floppy disk at bottom center, drawn numerals along the margins, and a central layered column of printed ephemera, braided cord, patterned fabric, and a small biplane image positioned near a photographed face fragment.

title: Reliquary
description: Lace doilies border a rectangular collage centered on a yellow Latin cross, above which six black vertical bars extend upward, each topped with a silver compact disc. Additional CDs line the lower interior edge and outer border, set against layered translucent fabric with printed text and a violet ground.

title: Sortie
description: Two oversized gold compact discs sit in concentric black-and-white halos in the upper register; below, a top-down line drawing of a single-engine warplane is centered on a blue bullseye. A frieze of small scoring targets runs along the base, with vertical orange and black bands dividing the field.

title: Alley, Magenta Figure
description: Narrow urban alleyway surfaces covered in layered spray-paint murals, including a central white-plastered section depicting a magenta-headed figure wearing oversized purple-and-yellow sunglasses above a skeletal torso in red and black. Flanking walls carry additional multicolored tags and characters; a silver Moto Guzzi Griso motorcycle is parked at the base.

Two top-down warplane line drawings drift across a silver foil ground, partially overlapping. A wooden chess king stands as a counterweight at lower left; silver compact discs anchor the upper corners and beaded fringes hang at the base.
title: Endgame

description: Mixed-media collage on black ground incorporating multiple compact discs—including a pink Verbatim CD-R and several silver-toned discs—overlaid with line-drawn warplane diagrams, a wooden chess king piece, yellow target stickers, iridescent foil fragments, and beaded cord arranged across layered transparent and reflective surfaces.
title: Squadron with Pink Vinyl
Procession
description: Vertical totem composition on pale yellow ground: a warplane photograph positioned at the apex descends through tiered arrangements of gold and silver compact discs, hand-drawn concentric circles, grid-patterned paper strips, and a black photographic band at lower center, flanked by four vertical yellow painted lines.

Top-down line drawing of a propeller warplane with RAF roundels occupies the upper portion of a white ground, bisected by two vertical yellow bands. Below, collaged elements include a gold scallop-patterned rectangle bearing a turquoise star, three silver compact discs, a football, a concentric-circle target, and rows of printed dots along the right margin.
title: Drafting Table

description: Two top-down warplanes overlap diagonally on a textured gold-leaf and silver-foil ground, one ghosted with bullseye eyes. A wooden chess king holds the lower-left corner; gold and iridescent discs cluster in the corners over a faint scoring sheet.
title: Treasury

description: Mixed-media collage layering compact discs, yellow tape strips, holographic foil fragments, and printed technical diagrams onto a perforated white ground. Centrally positioned, a hand-drawn aircraft outline incorporates iridescent CDs as landing gear and engine components, surrounded by target rings, red ink splashes, and photographic fragments at the lower register.
title: Float

description: Three silver compact discs cascade down a gold-foil ground over a top-down line drawing of a single-engine warplane. Strips of red lettering and small game-target stickers line the upper edge; the surface is densely worked, with overlapping foils and crease marks.
title: Untitled (Three Discs Descending)

description: Mixed-media collage incorporating three iridescent compact discs suspended over overlapping printed ephemera, including a technical warplane diagram, concentric target motifs, and photographic fragments. Orange vertical bands and red diagonal elements intersect a lower register of numbered columns and small figurative imagery against a predominantly pale ground.
title: Untitled (Iridescent Squadron)
Hieroglyph
description: Collaged layers juxtapose a reproduced Egyptian wall-painting of a seated deity—bearing a solar disc headdress and hieroglyphic register above—with a line-drawn warplane ascending from below. Yellow tape strips run vertically across the composition; compact discs occupy upper corners; a football helmet, iridescent sequin strips, and scattered marbles accumulate at the lower edge.

title: Disc Crucifix
description: Mixed-media assemblage incorporating five iridescent compact discs arranged along a T-shaped form above layered panels of reflective black, dark green, and white materials. White cables and wires hang loosely downward from the central structure, alongside small electronic components and blue-painted fragments affixed to the surface.

title: Gold Cross
description: Cross-shaped assemblage constructed from gold metallic panels, four compact discs, and layered mixed-media detritus, centered against a red-and-white cruciform field on a black ground. Reflective surfaces, fragmentary electronic components, and vinyl-like material cover the cross's interior, with red-painted passages visible beneath.

Mixed-media collage centered on a top-down line-drawn warplane over layered CD-R packaging, holographic foil, and iridescent tape. Four Skilcraft compact discs are affixed at corners; a football, red helmet, paper clips, and concentric target forms occupy the lower register alongside yellow-accented gear shapes.
title: Fuselage and Helmet
Untitled (Football and Vinyl)
description: Mixed-media collage incorporating compact discs, vinyl records, holographic foil, technical schematic paper, football trading cards, a red helmet, and a brown football arranged across a white ground. Vertical color-bar strips and concentric-circle targets occupy the left and right margins, while iridescent disc surfaces reflect multiple colors throughout the composition.

Multiple top-down warplane line drawings stack in a vertical formation against a field crowded with gold compact discs, red rocket-fin shapes and concentric target rings. Vertical orange and black bands divide the composition; printed numerals and tags pile at the base.
title: Formation

description: Mixed-media collage incorporating three gold compact discs, a side-view warplane drawing, postage stamps, polaroid-style photographic prints, and multicolored painted ribbons against a predominantly white ground. Concentric target rings appear at upper center and lower left, alongside holographic foil fragments, hand-drawn architectural lines, and bold red, yellow, and black gestural strokes.
title: Untitled (Polaroid Drift)

description: Layered fragments of printed ephemera—a football trading card, photoprints, paper clips, and compass drawings—overlay a warplane outline rendered in fine linework at left, with bold vertical color bands in red, yellow, and blue. Concentric target circles and a compact disc dominate the right half against a dark blue ground.
title: Untitled (Plane and Disc, Wide)

description: Layered collage elements across a horizontal format include two iridescent compact discs set within concentric circular targets, outlined propeller-aircraft drawings, diagonal pastel bars, a soccer ball, an Arsenal Football Club logo, and dense overlapping fragments of printed ephemera, color-block tape, and photographic imagery on a cream ground.
title: Wide Score

description: Mixed-media collage incorporating compact discs, printed ephemera, football imagery, and iridescent foil arranged around a centered top-down aircraft line drawing. Vertical orange stripes cross the composition; concentric black-and-white target circles, a holographic crown element, and a Rolling Stones tongue logo punctuate the densely layered field.
title: Crowned Plane

description: Centered top-down outline of a military aircraft overlays concentric black-and-white target rings, surrounded by collaged printed ephemera including gold compact discs, bullseye targets, photographic snapshots, red and orange vertical ribbon forms, and a football, arranged across a dense multi-layered white ground.
title: Bombsight

description: Layered printed ephemera and physical objects—compact discs, archery targets, Rolling Stones tongue-and-lips logos, an Arsenal badge, and an engineering-drawing warplane—are collaged across a black ground with vertical red and yellow paper strips. Gold glitter material occupies the center, flanked by four silver CDs along the lower register and a small football at lower right.
title: Tongue and Plane
Cloud Garden
description: Five gold compact discs are affixed across a loosely painted white ground featuring gestural blue and green brushwork depicting a schematic face with circular eyes. Collaged USPS Express Mail labels, two outlined aircraft, a small snowman figure, and multicolored rectangular patches occupy the composition's margins and lower register.

title: Yellow Figure on Black Wall
description: Yellow stenciled human silhouette, posed mid-stride, sits centered within a layered spray-painted field of magenta, red, and orange on a black wall covered with overlapping white and turquoise graffiti tags. Small snowman motifs flank the central figure; cyan bubble lettering occupies the lower register alongside a partially visible printed flyer.

title: Untitled (Twin Planes)
description: Two top-down warplane drawings stack vertically on a gold-foil ground. Three gold compact discs anchor the upper field; a small linear bird and a band of sequined dots sit below the lower plane.

Large-scale mixed-media mural covering an entire wall, densely layered with collaged imagery including footballs, concentric target circles, chess pieces, cameras, and photographic fragments rendered in saturated reds, blacks, yellows, and whites. Painted and printed elements overlap continuously across the surface without visible negative space.
title: Installation View, Wall of Works
Installation View, Crowd
description: Wide installation photograph of a large white-ground mural densely covered in concentric circles, planes, footballs and target patterns. Three viewers stand in silhouette in the foreground, giving scale.

Top-down rendered warplane in cyan and dark ink overlaps a horizontal cyan band dividing the composition into two registers. Below, five gold compact discs and three circular orange-and-black target graphics are distributed across a pale architectural grid background.
title: Untitled (Diving Plane)

description: Layered digital collage featuring a rendered Stuka dive-bomber descending over partial cyan text, above a pale grid field populated with concentric target circles and a cubist-style reclining figure; two compact discs appear at left edge and lower center, with a horizontal orange-red gradient band bisecting the lower third.
title: Stuka, Watch Out

description: Wide horizontal collage-style composition dense with overlapping motifs: concentric bullseye targets in black, red, and pink; football forms; biplane silhouettes; chess pawn figures; vertical yellow bands; and hand-lettered text reading 'dias' at center. Red, black, white, and yellow dominate across a frieze-like expanse approximately three times wider than tall.
title: Long Frieze

description: Mixed-media collage on a horizontal ground incorporates USPS Priority Mail envelopes, outlined warplane silhouettes, concentric target circles, iridescent compact discs, a football, red chess pawn, cartoon figure cutouts, and neon yellow and red rectangular overlays. Layered printed ephemera and hand-drawn elements occupy the entire picture plane in a dense, overlapping arrangement.
title: Untitled (Twin Discs in Targets)

description: Dense collage across a horizontal format incorporates outlined warplane silhouettes, compact discs, concentric target motifs, football forms, graffiti lettering, and vertical red and yellow color blocks on a white ground. Handwritten text fragments appear at multiple edges alongside ink splashes and stenciled figures.
title: Hangar

description: Three-panel horizontal collage incorporating black-outlined warplane drawings, gold compact discs, and concentric circular target motifs scattered across white grounds. Layered elements include chess pieces, handwritten text, photographic fragments, red paint splatters, and multicolored striped borders dividing the panels.
title: Untitled (Plane Diptych)

description: Horizontal mixed-media collage dominated by repeated concentric roundels in red, white, blue, and black distributed across a white ground alongside silver compact discs. Linear outline drawings of propeller aircraft are interspersed with vertical yellow stripes, painted gestural marks in red and yellow, and fragmentary photographic and printed paper elements.
title: Roundel Field
Snake on a Stairwell
description: Black-and-white serpent mural spans diagonally across a concrete wall beneath an exterior metal staircase, its open-fanged head rendered in bold outline style. Below the stairs, a pasted cartoon toast character with limbs occupies the lower section; four HVAC units are mounted at the upper wall, and a red commercial bin sits at ground level.

title: Untitled (Football Frieze)
description: Wide horizontal collage: a row of bullseye targets and footballs runs across the lower margin while two top-down warplane drawings cross the upper field. Red, yellow and black accents punctuate the white ground.

title: Resin and Rust
description: Two rust-brown resin rectangles separated by a horizontal band of pale blue tape occupy the left two-thirds of the composition, while the right section consists of layered cream and pale green panels joined by four gold compact discs used as fasteners, with a small blue square visible at the upper edge.

title: Roundel Procession
description: Vertical mixed-media collage incorporating a hand-drawn warplane, scattered compact discs, multiple concentric-circle targets in red, blue, green, and yellow, and two footballs against a white ground. Four yellow vertical bands bisect the composition; a small framed image is affixed near center, and the word 'GUERNICA' appears in the lower third.

Collage elements—compact discs, concentric target roundels, a yellow-bordered inset depicting a warplane and pink football—scatter across a white ground with pencil-drawn outlines of vehicles. Along the right margin, vertically stacked iridescent discs and horizontal color-bar stripes anchor the composition.
title: Untitled (Sketch, Pink Ball)
Inventory 10054
description: Mixed-media collage incorporating target concentric circles, two footballs, a small photographic insert depicting a red automobile, handwritten text listing names, and gestural ink markings across a white ground. Cutout figures, gear forms, a syringe illustration, and typed numerals '10054' layer over painted spiral and radiating motifs in red, black, and yellow.

Layered collage of aircraft technical diagrams, concentric target rings, vinyl record discs, and bold pink and yellow planes of color across a predominantly white ground. Recurring bullseye motifs in red, black, and cyan overlap drawn warplane silhouettes, a chess-piece profile, gridded schematics, and typographic fragments throughout the densely packed vertical composition.
title: Untitled (Helicopter on Targets)
Cardboard Field
description: Quiet brown corrugated-cardboard field interrupted by a vivid orange rectangle at upper center and a turquoise football icon below. Small printed snapshots and two CDs anchor the lower edge; restrained palette unusual for the artist.

title: Untitled (Target Field, Wide)
description: Collaged mixed-media composition on a horizontal field populated with concentric target circles, compact discs, two red American footballs, and a drawn warplane silhouette against a cream and ochre ground. Red orthogonal lines traverse the surface, overlapping printed ephemera, photographic fragments, and blue radiating arc forms distributed across multiple registers.

Vertical mixed-media collage incorporating a top-down technical drawing of a warplane centered on a white ground, flanked by concentric target circles in red, black, and white. Scattered elements include a football, helmet, chess piece, compact discs, postage stamps, and the stenciled word 'WHAT,' with red rectangular patches and striped borders framing the composition.
title: Untitled (Plane Totem with Text)
Crown of Polaroids
description: Collaged mixed-media composition incorporating two compact discs mounted on concentric target circles, a red zigzag crown form, football trading cards in a horizontal strip, an American football image, and a small airplane outline against a pale blue ground, with a strip of repeated sports photographs along the upper margin.

title: Rhode, White Figure
description: Layered street-art markings cover a black metal wall, centered on a white paste-up figure of a standing nude with loosely rendered features. Yellow spray-painted lettering, a cartoon character with large concentric eyes, white line-drawn tags, and scattered graffiti inscriptions in white and yellow surround the central figure.

Dense collage incorporating repeated motifs—footballs, concentric bullseye targets, chess pawns, compact discs, and aircraft outlines—layered across a white ground bisected by bold red and black vertical bands. Gold foil, holographic material, and painted passages accumulate across the horizontal field alongside scattered soccer balls and cartoon figures.
title: Untitled (Dense Field)
Dad, Two Footballs
description: Mixed-media collage on white ground incorporates painted target circles, two footballs, collaged compact discs along the upper edge, and a central orange-framed inset depicting a warplane silhouette against black. Scattered across the surface are a small sculptural face, a gray figurative cutout, blue-arc lines, and hand-lettered text reading 'DAD' at lower right.

title: Foil Cross
description: Horizontal mixed-media assemblage incorporating reflective mylar sheeting, a cross-shaped foil structure mounted at upper center, and thirteen gold compact discs distributed across the composition. Red vertical ribbon strips descend against the mirrored ground; a computer keyboard lies detached to the left on a white surface, with printed labels and white cord elements visible throughout.

Densely packed square composition: top-down warplane drawings rise from a base inscribed 'GUERNICA', surrounded by footballs, target rings and silver compact discs. The signature war narrative compacted into a single saturated panel.
title: Guernica

description: Collaged mixed-media composition featuring two gold compact discs positioned at the upper register above a top-down aircraft schematic overlaid with concentric target rings and reel-to-reel imagery. Surrounding margins incorporate warplane motifs, orange and green geometric blocks, yellow diagonal lines, and a horizontal row of red-and-white bullseye circles along the lower border.
title: Untitled (Framed Plane on Targets)
Untitled (Two Boards)
description: Two stacked rectangular panels: the upper has a black chess king and music note, the lower a red-and-black 'PINTE' panel with chess pieces. Silver compact discs ring the outer edge; small icons and text scribbles fill the margins.

Dense accumulation of collaged elements—concentric target rings, compact discs, chess pieces, skateboards, and printed text fragments—distributed across a white ground overlaid with red and yellow geometric grid lines. Circular motifs in black, red, yellow, and blue recur at varied scales throughout the composition, interspersed with schematic drawings and handwritten inscriptions.
title: Untitled (Skateboards on Target Field)

description: Wide horizontal mixed-media collage centered on a yellow rectangular panel bearing two silver compact discs as eyes, forming a face-like configuration framed by thick black arcs. Concentric target circles, aircraft silhouettes, football forms, handwritten text reading 'XXXIII,' red and green vertical bands, and scattered circular motifs populate the surrounding white ground.
title: XXIII Bus

description: Multiple warplane silhouettes rendered in black line drawing occupy a yellow-and-white ground, arranged in overhead perspective across the horizontal field. Scattered compact discs, concentric target circles, photographic strips, and the hand-lettered phrase "THE KING OF" populate the surrounding collaged surface alongside small figure groups and vertical orange rectangles.
title: Untitled (Three Planes, Yellow)

description: Grid-based mixed-media collage composed of overlapping rectangular panels on a white ground, populated with rendered warplane silhouettes, concentric target circles in black, red, and multicolor, football imagery, chess pieces, and repeated stenciled text reading 'OTHER.' Orange, red, and white tones dominate the lower registers.
title: Untitled (Plane Grid, OTHER)
Occupy Democracy
description: Paste-up mural on a black ground depicts an ochre-yellow silhouetted profile of a crowned figure occupying the upper register, overlaid with repeated 'occupydemocracy' text strips and red lettering reading 'BEN NAZ.' Below, a grey-blue owl rendered in hatched brushwork adjoins a white Georgian door numbered 178A bearing small red snowman tags.

title: Guernica, Tall
description: Vertical digital collage bearing the text 'GuErNiCa' in mixed-case letters across a red-and-black urban texture at top; below, mirrored fragmented faces with yellow eyes are overlaid by horizontal color bands—cyan, yellow, red—while warplane silhouettes and compact discs occupy the lower registers against black-and-white photographic strips.

title: Falling City
description: Vertical composite assembled on a white ground: mirrored photographic portrait fragments with orange eyes are overlaid with cyan, yellow, and red color-field bands, surmounted by a descending warplane silhouette rendered in teal and green. Below, a dense black-and-white aerial photograph of a destroyed urban landscape forms the base register.

title: Guernica, Bomber Above
description: Vertical collage juxtaposing a cyan field bearing a schematic four-engine bomber overhead with the word 'GuErNiC' in white bold type on green; below, a red rectangle frames a black-and-white photograph of a ruined building and tree, with a dense photographic band of figures and rubble at bottom.

title: Foil Cross with Wires
description: Cross-shaped assemblage constructed from cardboard, crumpled copper-toned foil, compact discs, and small electronic components, mounted against a layered metallic and red-striped background. White wires descend loosely from the horizontal arms; a small purple-labeled disc is affixed near the lower vertical shaft, and yellow painted marks are visible at center.

title: Untitled (Page on Bands)
description: Mixed-media collage centered on a white rectangular panel bearing scattered paint marks and handwritten text, overlaid on vertical yellow bands; surrounding field incorporates concentric target motifs, compact discs, printed ephemera, black brushwork, and fragments of photographic and grid-patterned materials in red, blue, gold, and black.

Collage elements—floppy disks, compact discs, cassette tape strips, and painted yellow vertical bands—form a rectangular frame enclosing a white void on a textured white ground. Six gold-toned CDs line the lower edge, two positioned as oversized reel spools, while multicolored circular motifs and mixed-media fragments populate the bottom register.
title: Cassette
Untitled (Page on Targets)
description: Mixed-media collage centering a white rectangular panel mounted with two silver compact discs and a translucent form, bordered by concentric target circles in red, black, pink, and blue. Scattered elements include a black chess king figure, football fragments, printed text reading 'xxxiii dia,' additional CDs, and horizontal bands of graphic patterning along the perimeter.

title: Untitled (Three Discs, Wide)
description: Collaged elements across a horizontal white ground include three Discraft compact discs positioned at varying heights, a row of concentric bullseye targets along the lower register, and geometric cutouts in cyan, orange, and red triangles at right. Photographic fragments depicting a football, chess pawn, and stacked discs occupy the left and lower margins.

title: Untitled (Three Discs, Quiet)
description: Three silver compact discs—one small in the upper right, one medium at mid-left, one large at center-lower—are arranged across an aged white ground bearing stain marks and edge perforations. Below the largest disc, a small technical drawing of a top-view aircraft appears above a red horizontal band at the bottom margin.

Two horizontal warplane line drawings stack in the central register, surrounded by gold and silver compact discs and concentric rings. Pink, magenta and yellow ribbon stripes punctuate the field; a chess king stands at lower left and a bullseye anchors the base.
title: Untitled (Twin Planes with Discs)
Stencil Girl, Brick Wall
description: Black-and-white spray-paint stencil on weathered yellow brick depicting a child's face and torso, holding an object printed with repeating dollar signs rendered in white against black. Two small secondary stencils—a figure with glasses and a three-circle snowman—appear near the upper wall edge.

Crowded margins frame a near-empty central white panel: silver and gold compact discs, footballs, target rings, chess pieces and a soccer ball cluster densely along the four edges. The empty center reads as a pause within a busy field.
title: Untitled (White Frame, Crowded Margins)

description: Three gold compact discs anchor an inset white square at center, tagged with the painted words 'london' below and 'LIVERPOOL' on a yellow tab. A small line-drawn warplane, target rings and a black-and-white photographic strip frame the inset.
title: London, Liverpool
Untitled (Three Discs Above OTHER)
description: Three silver compact discs cluster in the central register over a base inscribed 'OTHER'. A small top-down warplane rises at the upper edge; a row of red-and-black bullseye targets and a magenta football line the lower frieze.

Two top-down warplane drawings drift across the upper white field, one trailing a small cloud and red flag boxes; the painted word 'SURPRISE' marks the right edge. A horizontal row of gold compact discs and twin red bullseyes runs along the base. A wooden chess king stands at upper left.
title: Surprise
Cassette Altar
description: Vertical assemblage composed of layered paper documents, compact discs, blue tape strips, crumpled metallic foil, and assorted electronic components including a keyboard and small appliances, arranged against a black ground. Iridescent CDs appear in two registers—upper row affixed to white printed sheets, lower cluster mounted amid reflective foil and tangled cables.

On a black ground a single white-line top-down bomber drawing hovers central, with two silver compact discs flanking targets at the lower edge. A small white chess king floats at upper left; teal accent strips punctuate the right side.
title: Bomber, Black Ground

description: Layered collage elements—target rings in black-and-white and multicolor, multiple aircraft silhouettes in overhead and side-view orientations, two gold compact discs, and pale yellow drip marks—surround a central white panel bearing a single line-drawn jet. Cardboard, tape strips, and fragmented printed ephemera form the borders.
title: Untitled (Plane on Empty Page)

description: Four silver compact discs overlap a dense field of pencil-drawn warplane silhouettes rendered in multiple scales and orientations on a white ground. Red rectangular borders, vertical orange drips, concentric target circles in black and red, a blue X, and a partial magenta football accumulate across the surface; 'XXIII DBS' is inscribed lower right.
title: XXIII Discs

description: Negative-image variant: a black-ground panel hosts white-line top-down warplanes stacked vertically, framed by perforated borders and a base frieze of black-and-white concentric targets. Two silver compact discs sit in the lower margin.
title: Negative Squadron

description: Companion to the red-bordered XXIII piece, recast in cobalt blue: vertical blue stripes carry a flock of warplanes; iridescent and silver compact discs scatter across the upper field. Black-and-white target rings cluster at the base; inscribed 'XXIII DBS' lower right.
title: XXIII Discs, Blue
Star of David, Snowman
description: Red and violet ground supports overlapping white-outlined triangles forming a six-pointed star configuration, centered on a vertically oriented stylized automatic rifle rendered in green, black, and white. Within the lower inverted triangle, a small white snowman figure is depicted; yellow brushstrokes and gestural marks populate the layered background.

Collaged on a white ground, multiple concentric target circles, line-drawn warplane silhouettes, a photographic football, black-and-white photographic fragments, and a chess piece are distributed across the vertical composition. Handwritten script appears along the right edge alongside thin colored strips of yellow, red, and green.
title: Football Drift

description: Two warplane silhouettes—a small single-engine fighter at center and a large four-engine bomber at the lower edge—occupy a white paper ground marked with dotted runway lines, a circular pencil arc, target roundels, and two compact discs near the upper margin. Handwritten inscription reading 'Merry Christmas 2013 Allison' runs along the bottom edge.
title: Merry Christmas 1
Football, Black Ground
description: On a near-black ground a single American football looms at centre, surrounded by small bullseye eyes, scattered photographic snapshots and a wide horizontal red line. Hot-pink accents flicker at the upper edge; a small line-drawn warplane at the right.

Companion to the white-ground Christmas piece, recast on a black ground: a small green-and-white fighter at the upper centre approaches a four-engine bomber at the base. Two gold compact discs hang in the upper field; a circular ghost trace centres the composition.
title: Merry Christmas 2013, Black

description: Vertical mixed-media composition centered on a white rectangular void bordered by an ochre ground, with bilateral columns of concentric bullseye targets and gold compact discs flanking the central panel. Top-plan line drawing of a propeller aircraft appears above; a wooden chess bishop occupies the lower left corner alongside a black-and-white photographic fragment and handwritten text.
title: Yellow Frame, Blank Page
Tower Altar
description: Vertically oriented mixed-media assemblage set against a black ground, incorporating blue tape strips, corrugated brown panels, speaker hardware, crumpled metallic foil, red ribbon elements, and a lower register of stacked white-and-navy printed bands from which thin cables hang downward.

Variant of the yellow-frame composition with twin chess kings — one black at lower left, one white at lower right — flanking a central blank panel. Silver and red bullseye target rings line the columns; a top-down warplane drawing crowns the top edge.
title: Yellow Frame with Two Kings

description: Two warplane silhouettes—one overhead view at top center, one four-engine bomber at lower edge—frame a black inset panel depicting a ruined urban skyline. Flanking vertical columns of concentric target rings, three iridescent compact discs, and a chess bishop at lower left occupy a dark ground scattered with faint star marks.
title: Night Mission

description: Mixed-media collage incorporating warplane diagrams, concentric target motifs, reflective compact discs along the lower edge, a chess pawn, football forms, and iridescent vertical strips against layered red, black, and beige ground. Centrally embedded is a dark photographic inset depicting a figure in red and blue tones, surrounded by scattered circular targets and technical aviation schematics.
title: Red Stage, Two Planes

description: Three silver compact discs cluster across the lower half of a near-empty white field, with a fourth disc upper right. A single green vertical band drops from a maroon football panel at top; small target rings and CD fragments line the lower edge. A scribbled bicycle silhouette runs through the centre.
title: Football, Three Discs, Green Stripe
Sticker Wall, CAID
description: Densely layered stickers and paste-ups covering a wooden wall surface, featuring hand-printed portraiture, cartoon characters, typographic tags including 'CAID,' 'TOIZ,' and 'MORE STREET FOR ART,' and a large white die-cut skull figure centered among approximately twenty overlapping rectangular prints in red, yellow, blue, black, and white.

Mixed-media collage on a cyan and grey ground incorporates warplane silhouettes, concentric black-and-white target rings at multiple positions, a leaping animal figure, vertical beaded or braided strands descending centrally, and scattered compact discs, chess pieces, and architectural blueprint fragments. Human facial elements, a hat-wearing figure, and grid-patterned photographic sections occupy the upper register.
title: Cyan Bombsight

description: Collaged mixed-media composition on a dark ground featuring multiple compact discs arranged at corners and along the bottom edge, their iridescent surfaces reflecting blue, green, and gold. Vertical pink and lavender strips descend through the center above a frieze of small discs, perforated borders, printed text fragments, and handwritten numerals reading 'xxxiii d17.'
title: Black Box, Iridescent Discs

description: Multiple warplane outline drawings, oriented at varied angles, overlay a white ground bisected by vertical yellow paint drips and multicolored rope lines; compact discs and red rectangular markings appear as collage elements. Concentric-circle targets in red, black, and blue line the lower register, with additional bullseye forms and photographic fragments distributed across the composition.
title: Squadron Above Targets

description: Mixed-media collage incorporating technical warplane diagrams, gold and iridescent compact discs, concentric target motifs, yellow and red paper panels, a black chess pawn, and printed text reading 'HOW TO CREAT' arranged across a white ground. Overlapping layers include architectural floor-plan fragments, a pink silhouette profile, photographic elements, and black-and-white striped sections distributed throughout the composition.
title: Yellow Inset, How to Create

description: On a black ground a row of stereo speakers and components stretches across the upper register; below, three top-down warplane line drawings advance with concentric target rings flanking. A small ladder element climbs the left side; saturated cobalt and turquoise accents punctuate the dark field.
title: Stereo Squadron

description: Black borders studded with mounted compact discs run down both sides; the central white panel hosts a four-engine bomber line drawing with rivet-perforations descending below it. A maroon football and orange ribbon strip flank the lower edge; two gold discs sit at the base.
title: Bomber, Disc Frame
Disc Bouquet
description: Vertical assemblage of iridescent compact discs arranged in symmetrical clusters across red, blue, and gold zones, set against plastic-wrapped backing with reflective surfaces. Below a horizontal band of speaker-like forms and layered discs, a red-ground frieze displays repeated white silhouette figures bordered by rows of circular rivets and flanked by vertical red rods.

Variant of the XXIII series in yellow: four gold compact discs arrange diamond-formation across the centre over a layered field of warplane drawings, equipment fragments and red blocks. Black-and-white perforated borders frame the top and bottom; a pink scribbled column drops at lower left, with a target medallion at right.
title: XXIII Discs, Yellow

description: Companion to the XXIII series in magenta and black: a vertical pair of top-down warplane drawings hovers central, framed by black-and-white perforated borders and dripping pink columns. A small line-drawn elephant clings to the upper left; concentric target rings flank.
title: XXIII Discs, Magenta

description: Five top-down warplane silhouettes stack in receding scale on a white field, the upper plane in solid colour, the lower in line drawing. Below, three blue cassette tapes carry compact discs as reels along the base.
title: Squadron and Cassettes
